NAME: AHB to APB bridge and shim verification plan
details: Block 8 and the shared wrapper: ahb2apb_bridge with its APB state machine, and garuda_apb_shim, which every peripheral sits behind. Source: GARUDA-AHB2APB-SPEC-001, decisions D-16, D-17, D-21, and the window map in garuda_system.yaml. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. The specification still says eleven windows in three places and that window 0 is unmapped; the map has twelve, window 0 being the SPI slave. Those lines need correcting.

NAME: A Transfer conversion
details: Spec 7.1.

NAME: F01 One AHB transfer becomes one APB3 transfer
details: IDLE, SETUP for one pclk, ACCESS, DONE. Address, direction and write data are the AHB transfer's; read data returns in the AHB data phase. Requirement R-1.
implementation_note: Method: sim (AHB master agent, APB slave agents, scoreboard) + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb window read and write; the APB protocol checker on four windows - 0 violations

NAME: sb_bridge
details: Every APB transfer compared with the AHB transfer that caused it, and every AHB response with the APB one.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_apb_setup
details: SETUP is exactly one pclk with PSEL high and PENABLE low.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_penable_needs_psel
details: PENABLE is never high without PSEL.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: apb_checker
details: Ten APB protocol rules, 0 violations, on every window.
implementation_note: tb/common/apb_checker.v, bound today on four windows.

NAME: F02 Address write data and direction are stable for the whole APB transfer
details: From SETUP to the end of ACCESS.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: only through the slave models' own check

NAME: a_apb_addr_stable
details: PADDR and PWRITE do not change while PSEL is high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_apb_wdata_stable
details: PWDATA does not change while PSEL is high on a write.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F03 The master is held until the response
details: hreadyout is low from acceptance to DONE; minimum four pclk, eight hclk. Spec [N-7.2], [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb

NAME: a_latency_min
details: A transfer with no wait states completes in exactly eight hclk cycles.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_latency
details: Peripheral wait states 0, 1, 3, 15.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F04 Back-to-back transfers
details: To the same window and to different windows with no idle cycle on the AHB side, reads and writes mixed.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_ahb2apb - 8 back-to-back writes to one window (BRG-1)

NAME: cg_brg.x_b2b
details: Same window and different window, each of the four read and write orders.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_bridge
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F05 Idle and busy transfers and an unselected bridge start nothing
details: HTRANS IDLE or BUSY, or hsel low, gives no APB activity.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: no check.

NAME: a_no_apb_without_request
details: PSEL rises only after a NONSEQ or SEQ transfer with hsel.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: B Windows
details: Spec 6.1, 7.7. Requirements R-2, R-8.

NAME: F06 Each of the twelve windows gets its own select
details: Window n is address bits 15:12; PSEL is one-hot or zero.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb windows 1, 5, 9, 11

NAME: a_psel_onehot
details: At most one PSEL bit is high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_window
details: Each of the 12 mapped windows read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F07 Windows 12 to 15 give an error and no select
details: A two-cycle AHB ERROR with no PSEL. Requirement R-8, spec [N-7.19].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb window 0xC and a masked window

NAME: a_unmapped
details: An access to an unmapped window never raises PSEL and ends in ERROR.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_unmapped
details: Windows 12, 13, 14, 15, read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F08 Address bits above the window decode
details: Bits 31:16 other than the APB base still inside the APB region - what the bridge does with them has to be read from the RTL and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_high_bits
details: An access at 0x4001_0000 and at 0x4FFF_F000.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: C Errors
details: Spec 7.4 to 7.6. Requirements R-6, R-7.

NAME: F09 Byte and halfword accesses are rejected
details: A two-cycle ERROR and no APB transfer. Requirement R-6, spec [N-7.12].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb [N-7.12]

NAME: a_subword_no_apb
details: No PSEL for a transfer whose size is not word.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_subword_error
details: Such a transfer ends in ERROR.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_brg.x_size_offset
details: Byte at offsets 0 to 3 and halfword at 0 and 2, read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F10 A peripheral that never answers
details: After 16 pclk with PREADY low the bridge ends the transfer with an ERROR and is usable again. Requirement R-7, spec [N-7.15].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb [N-7.15], one window

NAME: a_timeout_at_16
details: The timeout fires at exactly 16 pclk of ACCESS.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_no_hang
details: hreadyout is never low for more than a fixed bound.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_ready_at
details: PREADY at 0, 1, 14, 15 pclk of wait, at 16, and never.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F11 What the timeout does to the peripheral
details: On expiry PSEL and PENABLE drop with PREADY still low, which strict APB does not allow. Open item APB-1, needing an owner ruling.
implementation_note: Method: review, then sim. Today: APB-1 open

NAME: review
details: APB-1 in the bug register.
implementation_note: Open.

NAME: F12 PSLVERR becomes an AHB error
details: Two-cycle ERROR to the master; the next access is clean. Spec [N-7.20].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb [N-7.20]

NAME: a_slverr_prop
details: A transfer whose APB response has PSLVERR ends in ERROR, and one without does not.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F13 Every error is the two-cycle AHB sequence
details: hreadyout low with hresp high, then both high.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: checked only in the interconnect bench, where the bridge is a model

NAME: a_error_two_cycle
details: ERROR is exactly two cycles in that order.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: ahb_checker
details: AHB-Lite protocol checker on the bridge's slave port - 0 violations.
implementation_note: tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v. To be bound here.

NAME: D The two clocks
details: Spec 7.2. Requirements R-3, R-4.

NAME: F14 The hclk side is stable when the pclk side samples it
details: Captured address and write data do not change in the hclk cycle marked by pclk_phase. This is the property the whole no-synchroniser argument rests on. Spec [N-7.8].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: no assertion; named in a comment only

NAME: a_capture_stable_at_phase
details: The capture registers are stable in every cycle with pclk_phase high while a transfer is in flight.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F15 Every pclk edge is an hclk edge
details: Checked here and not assumed. Spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_crg t_pclk_div2 checks the ratio; no assertion

NAME: a_pclk_on_hclk
details: pclk changes only with an hclk rising edge.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F16 Transfers starting at either phase
details: An AHB request arriving in the hclk cycle before a pclk edge and in the cycle after one both give a correct APB transfer.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_request_phase
details: Request with pclk_phase 0 and 1, for reads and writes.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F17 Lint sees the boundary only when the block is alone
details: HAL reports one crossing on the bridge linted by itself and none at chip level.
implementation_note: Method: static. Today: waived in flow/2_static/hal_waivers.txt

NAME: hal_cdc
details: flow/2_static.
implementation_note: Done.

NAME: E Access rate per window
details: Spec 7.3. Requirement R-5.

NAME: F18 APB_DIV stretches the access phase
details: PENABLE held for 1, 2, 4 or 8 pclk before PREADY is sampled, per window, fixed at synthesis.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb - divide by 1 and by 2

NAME: a_apb_div
details: PENABLE is high for at least the configured number of pclk.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_div
details: Each of the four values on at least one window.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F Reset
details: Spec section 9.

NAME: F19 No transfer is acknowledged until both resets have released
details: hreadyout is low out of reset and stays low while preset_n is still asserted; a request made in that gap is held and then served. Spec [N-9.2], [N-9.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_ahb2apb [N-9.2], [N-9.3]

NAME: a_dual_reset_hold
details: hreadyout is 0 while either reset is asserted.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_reset_gap
details: A request before hreset release, between the two releases, and after both.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F20 A reset in the middle of a transfer
details: PSEL and PENABLE drop and the bridge returns to idle with no half-finished response.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_brg.cp_reset_phase
details: Reset in SETUP, in ACCESS and in DONE.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: G The APB shim
details: garuda_apb_shim, the wrapper every peripheral uses. Decisions D-17, D-21.

NAME: F21 Pass-through to the wrapped block
details: Offsets below the tail go to the block unchanged, or shifted right by ADDR_SHIFT for byte-addressed IP.
implementation_note: Method: sim (APB agents on both sides, scoreboard) + formal. Today: tb_apb_shim pass-through, ADDR_SHIFT = 2; APB checker on both sides - 0 violations

NAME: sb_shim
details: Every access on the inner side compared with the outer one.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_shim.cp_shift
details: ADDR_SHIFT 0 and 2.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F22 IRQSTAT captures events and holds them
details: Offset 0xFE0. A one-cycle event sets its bit; the bit stays until written 1; an event in the cycle of the clear, or a source still asserted, keeps it set.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_apb_shim [D-17], W1C, set beats clear

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: A bit whose source is high in the cycle of its clear is 1 afterwards.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_shim.x_irq_bit_when
details: Each bit; clear before, in the cycle of, and after the event; source held.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F23 IRQEN masks and the line is the OR
details: Offset 0xFE4. irq_o is the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN. A masked source is still captured.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_apb_shim

NAME: a_irq_level
details: irq_o equals the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F24 DMACTL and the request hold-off
details: Offset 0xFE8. The request is high while its source has data and its DMACTL bit is set; it drops for at least one pclk after every acknowledge. Decision D-21.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_apb_shim [D-21], dma_req_checker

NAME: a_dma_drop
details: dma_req_o is 0 in the pclk after dma_ack_i.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_shim.cp_dma_source
details: Source still full after the acknowledge, emptying on it, and refilling one cycle later.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F25 ID
details: Offset 0xFEC, read-only - 0x6A5D, the block number and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_apb_shim

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Reset value and access policy of the four tail registers.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F26 Offsets between the blocks registers and the tail raise PSLVERR
details: The limit is a parameter per block; defect SPIS-7 was a wrong value.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_apb_shim - one offset

NAME: a_shim_pslverr
details: PSLVERR is high for exactly the offsets at or above the limit and below 0xFE0, and above 0xFEC.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_shim.cp_limit_edge
details: The last mapped offset, the first unmapped one, 0xFDC, 0xFE0, 0xFEC, 0xFF0.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F27 Pad synchronisers
details: Two flops per asynchronous input, resetting to the idle level of the line.
implementation_note: Method: sim + static. Today: tb_apb_shim pad sync

NAME: a_sync_two_flops
details: A pad change is visible after two pclk and not before.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: cg_shim.cp_sync_reset
details: SYNC_RESET 0 and 1.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F28 The shim never stalls
details: PREADY is high in every cycle.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_apb_shim

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

details: Checked at chip level.

details: A register read and write in each of the twelve windows, an unmapped offset in each, a window that does not exist, and a byte access, each giving the right data or one precise fault.
